summary: Thin wrapper around the tire-brush force solver and physics-node propagation: acquires the tire-brush model lock (TireBrushModelForceSolver(1)), runs PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff over the physics node set dword_5EA2C0 with a distance value and context argument, then releases the lock (TireBrushModelForceSolver(0)) and returns the solver result.

operations.description: Acquire the tire-brush model lock via TireBrushModelForceSolver(1).
Propagate physics nodes with distance falloff via PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff on the node set dword_5EA2C0, passing the distance and context arguments.
Release the tire-brush model lock via TireBrushModelForceSolver(0).
Return the tire-brush solver result (value of the release call).

unresolved: Semantics of the distance argument (st0) and context argument (ecx) passed to PhysicsNodePropagationWithDistanceFalloff not resolved.
Return value purpose (the release call's result) not resolved.
